represents: Microsoft Entra sign-in telemetry for one tenant across the four diagnostic categories: interactive browser / desktop sign-ins with MFA, the usual failures and interrupts (bad password, MFA required, KMSI), silent token refreshes from Teams / Outlook / Azure CLI, daemon service principals using client secrets and certificates, GitHub Actions workload identity federation from the approved CI (federatedCredentialId populated) incl. a rejected untrusted-branch run, managed-identity token requests, and two legitimate device-code sign-ins (an admin's `az login --use-device-code` on a headless VM, a Teams Rooms device).
provenance: synthetic; shapes from the Azure Monitor diagnostic-setting sign-in schemas (SignInLogs / NonInteractiveUserSignInLogs / ServicePrincipalSignInLogs / ManagedIdentitySignInLogs) and the Microsoft Graph signIn resource (authenticationProtocol, originalTransferMethod, clientCredentialType, federatedCredentialId), Entra AADSTS error codes, and this repo's TRR9017 / TRR9023 fixtures (properties.resultType as a string, status.errorCode as an int). First-party appIds are Microsoft's public ids; other ids are random GUIDs; users are role handles at example.com; ASNs are RFC 5398 documentation ASNs; addresses RFC 5737 / RFC 1918.
